lines.en: label amidorm15:
: Ami, open up. I’m bored.
lines.zh: : Ami，开门。我好无聊。

lines.en: : Coming! One second, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 来啦！等一下下，Sensei！

lines.en: I hear a few drawers slam shut from inside of Ami’s room and wonder what it is she could be doing there.
lines.zh: 我听见 Ami 房里传来几声抽屉猛关的声音，好奇她在里面捣鼓什么。

lines.en: But before those thoughts go anywhere substantial, the tapping of footsteps racing to the door drags me back to reality.
lines.zh: 还没等念头成形，一阵奔向门口的脚步声就把我拽回了现实。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux1
: Hi! Perfect timing.
lines.zh: : 嗨！来得正好。

lines.en: : Perfect timing for what, exactly? Because if you're going to make me do something-
lines.zh: : 什么来得正好？你要是打算支使我干活——

lines.en: scene backinheatredux2
: Of course I'm going to make you do something. That’s my job.
lines.zh: : 我当然要支使你。那是我的职责。

lines.en: : Your job is to cook and clean for me, not force me back into the world when I'm finally able to get away from it.
lines.zh: : 你的职责是给我做饭打扫，不是在我好不容易逃离世界的时候，把我塞回去。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux3
: Oh, stop. It's not like I'm asking you to do anything serious. I just need you to come grocery shopping with me so Maya stops complaining about not having anything to drink.
lines.zh: : 哎，别闹。又不是什么大事。我就是需要你陪我去买点东西，好让 Maya 别再抱怨没喝的。

lines.en: : Tell Maya to get her own drinks. She’s scarily independent. I'm sure she can manage.
lines.zh: : 让 Maya 自己去买。她独立得吓人，肯定搞得定。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux1
: She’s also super lazy. And I’m kinda running out of stuff too, so I just figured I'd go for a walk and fix the problem on my own.
lines.zh: : 但她也懒得出奇。而且我家的存货也快见底了，所以我本来想着出去散个步，顺手把问题解决。

lines.en: : Or at least that's what I was going to do. But now you get to come with me.
lines.zh: : 至少我本来是这么打算的。但现在，你获得陪我去的机会了。

lines.en: : Is anything even open around here this late?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了，这附近还有店开着吗？

lines.en: : Mhm! There’s a corner store a few blocks away from here that’ll be open for another thirty minutes or so.
lines.zh: : 有！几个街区外有家街角小店，还能再开半小时左右。

lines.en: : It's good you showed up when you did, Sensei! You would have missed out on your chance otherwise.
lines.zh: : 你来得正是时候，Sensei！再晚一点，机会可就没了。

lines.en: : What is it with you two and getting me to carry stuff across town this late at night?
lines.zh: : 你们俩怎么都爱这么晚让我大老远搬东西？

lines.en: : It’s not “across town” Sensei, it’s like two blocks-
lines.zh: : 什么「大老远」，Sensei，就两个街区——

lines.en: scene backinheatredux4
: Wait. What did you just say?
lines.zh: : 等等。你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : I said that you are lucky I'm feeling generous tonight. Because otherwise, I would not do this.
lines.zh: : 我说的是，今晚我心情好、够大方，是你的运气。不然这种事我可不干。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux5
: Okay!
lines.zh: : 好吧！

lines.en: : Let's get a move on, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 出发吧，Sensei！

lines.en: scene black
And so the two of us make our way out of the dorms and into the street.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩走出宿舍，踏进街道。

lines.en: The hot summer air surrounds us, forcing us into a battle in which our respective resolves are tested as we are forced to walk another two blocks to our destination.
lines.zh: 炎热的夏夜空气包围了我们，把接下来两个街区的路，变成了一场考验各自意志的战斗。

lines.en: One of several things that Ami and I have in common is our mutual hate for extremely hot weather.
lines.zh: Ami 和我的共同点之一，就是对酷热天气的深切憎恶。

lines.en: So the fact that we have gone out at night, when temperatures are expected to be a bit cooler, and things are still like this?...
lines.zh: 所以，特意挑了本该凉快一点的晚上出门，结果还是这样？……

lines.en: Well, that's just fucking annoying.
lines.zh: 只能说，真他妈烦。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux6
: Guuuuuuuuuuuhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呜呜呜呜呜呜……

lines.en: : Yeah. I feel that.
lines.zh: : 懂。太懂了。

lines.en: : Why does it have to be so...sticky and gross outside?
lines.zh: : 为什么外面非得这么……黏糊糊、恶心兮兮的？

lines.en: : Whatever happened to cooler summer nights? And who was it that signed us up for this billion degree weather?
lines.zh: : 从前那种凉爽夏夜都去哪了？又是谁给我们报的名，来体验这十亿度的天气？

lines.en: : No clue. But I think you and I should probably have a word with them.
lines.zh: : 不知道。但我觉得，咱俩是该找那个人谈谈。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux7
: Hey, [amimaster]...
lines.zh: : 喂，[amimaster]……

lines.en: : What would you think about maybe going away somewhere soon?
lines.zh: : 要是最近找个地方出去走走，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : I would think that there are multiple problems with that suggestion.
lines.zh: : 我的评价是，这个提议存在多个问题。

lines.en: : Problems? Like what?
lines.zh: : 问题？比如？

lines.en: : Problem A: We can’t leave Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 问题 A：我们离不开 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : Who said we have to leave Kumon-mi? What if it was something simple? Like...the beach? Or an onsen or something?
lines.zh: : 谁说要离开 Kumon-mi 了？简单的地方不行吗？比如……海边？或者温泉之类的？

lines.en: : Problem B-
lines.zh: : 问题 B——

lines.en: : Can we just forget about Problem B and start making plans already?
lines.zh: : 问题 B 就先跳过，我们直接开始做计划行不行？

lines.en: : No. Because Problem B is that it’s still the middle of the[school] year. When would we even have time to go anywhere?
lines.zh: : 不行。因为问题 B 是，现在 [school] 学年才过半。我们哪来的时间去？

lines.en: : It can just be for the weekend or something! Like...maybe we could rent a shack near the beach and all hang out there for a night or two?
lines.zh: : 周末去就行啊！比如……在海边租个小屋，大家一起住上一两晚？

lines.en: : Don't you think it would be nice to get away, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 出去透口气，你不觉得很好吗，Sensei？

lines.en: scene backinheatredux8
: I know you hate this heat just as much as I do...So inside your head, you’re probably all like “Yaaaay water!” or “I finally get to see my [niece] in a swimsuit!” or something like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道你和我一样恨这鬼天气……所以你脑子里八成正在欢呼「耶，大海！」或者「终于能看我的 [niece] 穿泳装了！」之类的。

lines.en: : I am thinking nothing of the sort.
lines.zh: : 我可完全没这么想。

lines.en: I am.
lines.zh: 我想了。

lines.en: : In fact, the only thing that's running through my head at the moment is that Maya is going to have to get her own damn groceries next time.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我此刻脑子里唯一的念头是：下次让 Maya 自己滚去买她的东西。

lines.en: : Especially considering the fact that it looks like the store we're heading to is closing right now.
lines.zh: : 尤其考虑到，我们要去的那家店，看起来马上就要打烊了。

lines.en: scene backinheatredux9
: Wait, what?! No! Wait for us, old lady! We'll be quick, I promise!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！不要！等等我们，老板娘！我们很快的，我保证！

lines.en: scene black
Ami grabs my wrist and drags me to the front of the store with her, forcing me to bow and ask for the old woman to open back up for a few minutes.
lines.zh: Ami 抓住我的手腕，把我拽到店门口，逼我鞠躬恳求老太太重新开门几分钟。

lines.en: The woman obliges and I follow my [niece] as she fills a basket with an assortment of random items that I wind up not paying much attention to.
lines.zh: 老太太答应了。我跟在 [niece] 身后，看她往篮子里塞进一堆杂七杂八的东西——我最后也没怎么细看。

lines.en: And before long-
lines.zh: 没过多久——

lines.en: We’re back out in the heat.
lines.zh: 我们又回到了酷暑之中。

lines.en: scene amiheat1
: Bleeeeeeeeeeeeh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Who even invented weather in the first place? They’re stupid and I want them to know that.
lines.zh: : 到底是谁发明了天气这种东西？他是个笨蛋，我要让他知道。

lines.en: : No one “invented” weather, Ami. That's not a thing I should have to tell you.
lines.zh: : 天气不是谁「发明」的，Ami。这种事居然还要我告诉你。

lines.en: scene amiheat2
: I obviously know that, [amimaster]. I’m not an idiot.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道，[amimaster]。我又不是笨蛋。

lines.en: : Sure, I might be bad at math and science and...umm...all of the other subjects we have. But I've got a pretty good head on my shoulders, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我是数学不好、科学不好、嗯……所有科目都不好。但我的脑子还是很好使的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Then why are there leeks in your shopping bag? I don't remember them being on the list.
lines.zh: : 那你购物袋里的韭菜是怎么回事？我不记得清单上有它。

lines.en: scene amiheat3
: Wait...yeah. Why are there leeks in my shopping bag?
lines.zh: : 等等……对哦。我购物袋里为什么有韭菜？

lines.en: : How the heck did those even get in there?
lines.zh: : 它们到底是怎么混进去的？

lines.en: : I know the answer.
lines.zh: : 我知道答案。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那你快——

lines.en: : I snuck them in while you weren’t looking.
lines.zh: : 趁你不注意，我偷偷塞进去的。

lines.en: scene amiheat4
: You...snuck leeks into my basket?
lines.zh: : 你……把韭菜偷偷塞进我篮子？

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 是我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Sensei, what kind of weird practical joke is that?
lines.zh: : Sensei，这算什么奇怪的恶作剧？

lines.en: : I think it's less of a joke and more me simply being passively hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不算恶作剧，更算是我被动技能级别的幽默。

lines.en: : Your sense of humor is stupid.
lines.zh: : 你的幽默感很蠢。

lines.en: : Enjoy your leeks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 韭菜吃好喝好，Ami。

lines.en: : That aside, did you get everything else you needed?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，其他东西都买齐了吗？

lines.en: scene amiheat5
: Mhm. Soda for me and bunch of random milk tea thingies for Maya.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我自己买了汽水，还买了一堆乱七八糟的奶茶给 Maya。

lines.en: : You’re stocking up on soda? I figured you'd be a little more conscious about your health.
lines.zh: : 你在囤汽水？我以为你多少会更在意健康一点。

lines.en: : It’s fun to do things you know aren’t good for you every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 偶尔做点明知对身体不好的事，也挺有意思的。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
scene amiheat6
: But I’m sure you know all about that...don’t you, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 不过你肯定深有体会……对吧，[amimaster]？

lines.en: : Are you really saying what I think you’re saying right now?
lines.zh: : 你说的该不会就是我心里想的那件事吧？

lines.en: : Maybe. What do you think I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 说不定呢。你觉得我在说什么？

lines.en: : That you’ve found out about my secret girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你发现了我的秘密女友。

lines.en: : That’s right, I-
lines.zh: : 没错，我——

lines.en: scene amiheat7
: Wait, what?! Who is it?! I’ll kill her! You’re mine!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！是谁？！我要杀了她！你是我的！

lines.en: : I’m kidding, obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然，我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : You're referencing how our relationship has progressed past the point of us being just family. Right?
lines.zh: : 你说的是，我们的关系早就越过了「只是家人」的那条线。对吧？

lines.en: scene amiheat6
: Heheh...look at us, Sensei...Keeping something so naughty hidden from so many people.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……看看我们，Sensei……把这么不轨的事，瞒过这么多人。

lines.en: : Are you really trying to seduce me on a park bench just fifty feet away from a woman who sold you leeks a few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 你真打算在公园长椅上勾引我？离那位几分钟前把韭菜卖给你的女士，才十五米？

lines.en: scene amiheat7
: I never wanted these leeks! You did this! This is your fault!
lines.zh: : 我根本不想要这些韭菜！是你干的！都怪你！

lines.en: : And also no! I’m just stating facts!
lines.zh: : 还有，不是勾引！我只是在陈述事实！

lines.en: else:
scene amiheat8
: But...then again...
lines.zh: : 不过……话又说回来……

lines.en: : I guess you might not think so.
lines.zh: : 或许你不会这么觉得。

lines.en: There’s a certain sadness in Ami’s voice that I think I understand.
lines.zh: Ami 的声音里有种悲伤，我想我懂。

lines.en: A type of longing that most could not possibly fathom, but one that makes absolute sense to her.
lines.zh: 一种绝大多数人无从理解的渴望，对她而言却天经地义。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: I can’t do that with her.
lines.zh: 我不能对她那样。

lines.en: The two of us can't be anything more than this.
lines.zh: 我们俩不能再更进一步了。

lines.en: She’s been through enough already.
lines.zh: 她已经承受了太多。

lines.en: She doesn’t need the only person she has left in the world taking advantage of her, even if he wants to.
lines.zh: 她不需要这世上仅剩的那个人趁虚而入——哪怕那个人想。

lines.en: Which I'm not saying he does.
lines.zh: 我没说那个人想。

lines.en: We just...
lines.zh: 我们只是……

lines.en: We can't be like that.
lines.zh: 不能变成那样。

lines.en: : Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。

lines.en: scene amiheat9
: Hm?
: Let’s go on a vacation.
lines.zh: : 我们去度假吧。

lines.en: scene amiheat10
: Wait, really?! We can?!
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？！可以吗？！

lines.en: : I was only being half-serious when I suggested it before!
lines.zh: : 我刚才提的时候，只有一半是认真的！

lines.en: : Oh. Well, if that’s the case-
lines.zh: : 哦。这样啊，那——

lines.en: : No! No take-backs! You said vacation, so I’m getting a vacation whether you like it or not!
lines.zh: : 不行！覆水难收！是你说的度假，所以这个假我度定了，你同不同意都得度！

lines.en: : It will have to be somewhere close, obviously. We don't really have the time to go anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 当然只能去近的地方。我们也没有时间去别处。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. Obviously. Not like we have much of a choice anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊，当然。反正我们也没得挑。

lines.en: : Do you really have enough money to get all of us a place to stay, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你的钱真的够给我们所有人订住处吗？

lines.en: : All of us?
lines.zh: : 所有人？

lines.en: : Yeah. I mean, Maya and Ayane are coming too, right?
lines.zh: : 对啊。Maya 和 Ayane 也一起去，不是吗？

lines.en: : And if it’s some place like the beach, we might as well just invite the rest of the class too and have a huge vacation trip for everyone.
lines.zh: : 而且要是在海边那种地方，干脆把班里其他同学也叫上，搞一场全员大度假。

lines.en: And here I was thinking this was going to be a thing for just the two of us.
lines.zh: 我还以为这是我们两个人的事。

lines.en: Oh well, I guess. Not like I’m going to say no to hanging out with even more cute girls at once.
lines.zh: 算了，无所谓。一下子跟更多可爱女孩出去玩，这种事我总不可能拒绝。

lines.en: If anything, this is even better.
lines.zh: 说白了，这样反而更好。

lines.en: I just hope that having everyone in one place outside of school doesn't lead to any sort of drama.
lines.zh: 我只希望所有人校外聚在一起，别闹出什么幺蛾子。

lines.en: : Yeah...everyone can come.
lines.zh: : 行……大家都来吧。

lines.en: : It’s summer, so you should all be enjoying yourselves.
lines.zh: : 是夏天嘛，你们都该好好玩玩。

lines.en: scene amiheat12
: So should you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你也一样，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’ve always got that...tired look in your eyes that makes it seem like you just want to take a break from life.
lines.zh: : 你眼里总挂着那种……疲惫，好像一心只想从人生里请个假。

lines.en: : Let's hope that a vacation is what you need to pick yourself back up.
lines.zh: : 希望一场度假，正好能让你重新打起精神。

lines.en: scene amiheat13
: And if it’s not, I can always just give you a big hug instead. As many as you want.
lines.zh: : 要是不管用，我还可以抱抱你。要多少有多少。

lines.en: : That would probably work, right [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 那样肯定管用的，对吧，[amimaster]？

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概吧。

lines.en: : I think I’ll take the vacation instead, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，我还是选度假。

lines.en: scene amiheat7
: Be more excited about hugging your [niece], you jerk!
lines.zh: : 跟 [niece] 拥抱就不能兴奋一点吗，混蛋！

lines.en: scene black
The heat persisted until I dropped Ami back off at the dorm.
lines.zh: 酷暑一直持续到我把 Ami 送回宿舍。

lines.en: It didn't let up until I was already halfway home.
lines.zh: 直到我走到半路，它才肯松手。

lines.en: $ ami_love += 1
$ amidorm15 = True
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！
